authorization.request: 用户报告 DSH Desktop 商城推荐榜和必装榜读取失败（报 DESKTOP_RANKING_UNAVAILABLE_DESKTOP_RANKING_ENTRY_0_INVALID），要求解决此故障。

objective: 修复 DSH Desktop 推荐榜和必装榜因数据包含 packageName 属性导致校验失败拒绝加载的问题。

change.rootCause: 后台榜单管理增强时，marketplace/rankings/model.js 在榜单条目中增加了 packageName 属性，但 Desktop 客户端校验白名单 validateDesktopRankingSnapshot 未同步将 packageName 纳入合法可选键列表，导致首个条目即校验失败并拒绝整个榜单。
change.clientValidation: 在 optionalKeys 中增加 packageName，并增加字符串格式与长度安全校验，与榜单模型约束完全一致。在榜单行构建中优先复用该 packageName。
change.scopeExclusions: 不写真实 DSH Profile，不安装或重启 DSH，不修改 @deepseek-ai/*、DSH 源码或 Catalog pin；合并源码后如需更新 Catalog，另建绑定完整 Commit 的新鲜计划。

commands.expected: all disposable Desktop compatibility cases pass, including ranking packageName validation
REGISTRY_OK and full repository suite passes

gates: The plan base Commit remains an ancestor and every scoped precondition hash matches immediately before commit.
Ranking entries with valid packageName pass desktop ranking validation without altering board sorting or official slot allocation.
All repository checks, package dry-run, typed-plan verifier and exact-head PR CI pass before merge.
After source merge, Catalog pin advancement uses a separate fresh policy plan; real Profile update and visible Desktop acceptance require a separate confirmed operation.

rollback.source: Revert only this change through a CI-checked PR; current Catalog stays pinned to 0.9.44 until a separate release plan advances it.
rollback.desktopProfile: No real Profile, package or process mutation is included.

healthCheck: Run the disposable Desktop compatibility tests including ranking with packageName, npm run check, npm pack dry-run, typed-plan verification and exact-head PR CI. Report real Desktop/Profile acceptance separately.

verification.realDesktopProfile: unchanged; update and visible UI acceptance require separate confirmation
